page.text:
A relation $R$ on $X$ is *reflexive* when every element is related to
itself: $\forall x \in X, x \mathrel{R} x$. In geometric terms, this
means $R$ contains the diagonal $\Delta_X = \{(x, x) : x \in X\}$.
